options.text: Very good advice was given to the students by the counselor.
Very good advice is given to the students by the counselor.
Very good advice to the students has been given by the counselor.

__
 
• In Active Voice, a sentence emphasizes the subject, performing an action.
 
• In Passive Voice, a sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence.
 
• The given sentence is in the active voice and it is in the past simple tense.
 
• When we convert this sentence into a passive voice, the subject ''The counselor'' of the active voice becomes the object, the object ''very good advice'' becomes the subject.
 
• The active format "V2 (gave)" should be converted into the passive format "was + V3 (given)".
 
• This is the active and passive voice rule for the past simple tense.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

• Also, the **given sentence is a passive voice in the present simple tense**.
 
• In the **present simple**, the **passive format is**: **am/is/are + past participle (3rd form of the verb)**.
 
• Therefore, the past participle form of the verb 'limited' should be used in place of the base form of the verb 'limit'.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

• इसलिए base form of the verb 'limit' के स्थान पर past participle form of the verb 'limited' का प्रयोग किया जाना चाहिए।

• Sentence A will come after C as it is giving information about when the believer breaks his fast (only after sunset).
 
• The sentence 'B' is the concluding part as it is giving information about how the believer is able **to lead a life of self-discipline in all matters for the rest of the year** (by practicing self-restraint or fasting for one month in a year).

questions.question: Two numbers, A and B, are such that the sum of 3% of A and 6% of B is four-fifth of the sum of 4% of A and 6% of B. Find the ratio of A + B and A - B?

⇒ 15A + 30B = 16A + 24B

⇒ 6B = A

⇒ B/A = 1/6

∴ A = 6 and B = 1

⇒ A + B = 6 + 1 = 7

⇒ A - B = 6 - 1 = 5

A + B : A - B = 7 : 5

Thus, the correct answer is **"7 : 5".**

• The rivers Damodar, Brahmani, and Kharkai originate from the state of **Jharkhand **in India.
 
• Jharkhand fares poorly in terms of canal irrigation because the area is hilly.
 
• Most of the rivers of Jharkhand are seasonal in nature.
 
• They remain dry throughout the year but during the monsoon, season water gets overflowed in these rivers.

• The main concentration of canal irrigation is in the northern plain of India. The digging of canals in rocky and uneven areas is difficult and uneconomic.
 
• The undulating relief and hard rocks make it difficult to dig canals and wells.

questions.question: Which one of the following is a rare disease caused by the deficiency of Vitamin D that causes the bones to become soft and to bend?

__
 
• **Rickets is a childhood disorder of the bones where the bones become soft and prone to fractures. Bones tend to become weak due to an inadequate supply of nutrients, Vitamin D3 in particular.**
 
• It is also caused due to a** lack of calcium and phosphate** in the body. Weak bones can lead to bone deformities. Vitamin D largely comes from exposing the skin to sunlight.
 
• Other good sources of Vitamin D are fatty fish (such as tuna and salmon) and egg yolks.
 
• **Rickets** is a disease associated with the deficiency of **Vitamin D**.
 
• Rickets is of the following types:
 
 
• **Nutritional Rickets** -
 
 
• This is caused due to intake of food which lacks calcium, phosphorous, and vitamin D.
 
 
 
• **Hypophosphatemic Rickets-**
 
 
• It is caused due to low levels of phosphate. It is an X-linked genetic disorder where the kidneys are not able to control the amount of phosphate excreted in the urine.
 
 
 
• **Renal Rickets-**
 
 
• People suffering from kidney disorders have renal rickets. They are unable to regulate the amount of calcium and phosphate excreted in the urine.

• It is a decrease in red blood cells that occurs when the intestines cannot properly absorb vitamin B1.
 
• Vitamin B12 is also referred to as cobalamin because it contains a metal ion. Cyanocobalamin is used in vitamin supplements and pharmaceuticals.
 
• Symptoms of Vitamin B12 deficiency are the smoothness of the tongue, gastrointestinal disturbances, nervous symptoms.
 
 
 
• **Lupus:**
